content: Ayo ˆyakalooke, maa nkoona mʉryaango waywɨ́ɨrwe kurumwii. Aho, nkateera ɨra sawúti ˆnaarɨ natéɨɨre aho ncholo ˆɨrɨ ja sawúti ya irimʉ yoosea, “Ambʉka na kʉnʉ, nɨkoonekye masáare nɨ mpaka yafʉmɨre mpɨɨndɨ ɨhɨ ˆɨrɨ looka.”
Koonka, nkalongoolwa nɨ Mʉtɨma Mʉʉja, aho, nkoona ichuumbi ra kɨtemi ʉko kurumwii, na mweeri yaachwe nkoona ʉmwɨ ˆiíkyɨɨre.
Na ʉra ˆajáa iíkyɨɨre aho ichuumbii, alavalaváa ja mawye ya iyoombe ikʉʉlʉ ˆyaséwaa yásipi
Ichuumbi raachwe rɨjáa rarɨ́ɨngɨrɨɨrwe nɨ italavaási ˆralavalaváa ja iwye ra sumaríidi.

Ɨro ichuumbi rɨjáa rarɨ́ɨngɨrɨɨrwe nɨ machuumbi yɨɨngɨ makumi yavɨrɨ na yanɨ (24). Ayo machuumbi yajáa yiíkarɨɨrwe nɨ vawosi makumi yavɨrɨ na vanɨ (24) na vajáa viivɨ́kɨɨre ɨngo njerʉ chwee na mitwii vajáa viivɨ́kɨɨre matáaji ya saháabu.

Na kufuma aho ichuumbii ra kɨtemi, kʉkafuma ndávo, kukiririma na kɨdandárɨka. Na mbere ya ɨro ichuumbi ra kɨtemi kʉjáa kwatɨɨte vimʉrɨ mufungatɨ ˆvikórɨɨre. Vimʉrɨ ivyo, noo ɨra Mɨtɨma mufungatɨ wa Mʉlʉʉngʉ.

Kei, mbere ya ɨro ichuumbi ra kɨtemi kʉjáa kwatɨɨte kɨɨntʉ ˆkɨrɨ ja mayɨya ya kɨóo. Mayɨya ayo yajáa nɨ ja iwye kɨweerʉ ˆkɨlóokaniryaa. Katɨkatɨ ya rɨra ichuumbi ra kɨtemi na vara vawosi, kʉjáa kwatɨɨte viúumbe vine ˆviri mooyo. Ivyo viúumbe vijáa vyarɨɨngɨrɨra mavaru yoosi ya ichuumbi ra kɨtemi na vijáa vyatɨɨte miiso kɨra haantʉ.
Kiúumbe cha ncholo kɨjáa kiifwɨ́ɨne siimba, na cha kavɨrɨ kɨjáa kiifwɨ́ɨne mpachi na cha katatʉ kɨjáa chatɨɨte buuwo ja ya mʉʉntʉ na cha kanɨ kɨjáa ja mbeu ˆyoowʉlʉka.

Kɨra kiúumbe kɨjáa chatɨɨte mabava mʉsasatʉ. Ayo mabava yajáa yatɨɨte miiso kɨra haantʉ baa isii ya mabava. Viúumbe ivyo, vyɨɨ́mbaa uchikʉ na muusi bila yooreka, vyoosea, “Mʉʉja, Mʉʉja, Mʉʉja, Ijʉva Mʉlʉʉngʉ Mweenengururu joosi, ajáa amwaarɨ, amwaarɨ, na kʉva arɨ amwaarɨ!”
Kɨra mpɨɨndɨ ivyo viúumbe ˆvyamʉbweeyyiryáa nkongojima, ˆvyamʉdʉʉmbáa na ˆvyamʉnyemyáa ʉra ˆiíkalaa ichuumbi ra kɨtemi na ˆarɨ nkaasʉ kwa sikʉ ˆjisiina ʉhero,

vara vawosi makumi yavɨrɨ na vanɨ, valaaláa ɨsɨ na ɨnda voomwiinamɨra yeeye ˆarɨ nkaasʉ kwa sikʉ ˆjisiina ʉhero, ˆiíkalaa ichuumbii ra kɨtemi mbere yaachwe. Kei, vavɨɨkáa matáaji yaavo mbere ya ichuumbii ra kɨtemi kʉnʉ voosea,
